title: The 4-Part Prompt That Makes Claude Way More Useful
description: Vague prompts get vague answers. Use this simple 4-part formula (context, task, example, format) to get much better results from Claude. Follow for a new AI lesson every day. #shorts #ai #claude #prompting #learnai

scenes.narration: Vague prompts get vague answers. One simple formula fixes that.
Instead of: write a post about fitness. Try: three gym tips for beginners, under a hundred words.

visual.title: Vague vs *specific*
items: Vague: Write a post about fitness
Specific: 3 gym tips for beginners, under 100 words

scenes.narration: Use four parts. Give context. Set the task. Show an example. Choose the format.
Context is the secret weapon. Tell Claude who it's for and why. The more it knows, the better it can tailor the answer.

visual.title: *Context*
visual.subtitle: Who it's for, why you need it, what matters

scenes.narration: Here's one put together. I'm a beginner runner. Make a four-week 5K plan as a simple table.

visual.title: Try this prompt
items: I'm a beginner runner. Make a 4-week 5K plan as a simple table.
Here's a gentle 4-week plan: three short runs a week, building time slowly, with rest days in between.
